cautions.label: through 1 bridge
cautions.text: The best answer is reached through 1 bridge (through `OTTHUMG00000018151`): where Ensembl's history gives a gene no successor, the walk leaves it through an id it carries and enters another gene that carries the same id. That is IDTrack's inference; no record of Ensembl states it.

cautions.label: the bridge joins two genes of one time
cautions.text: `ENSG00000183675.10` (releases 62-75) and `ENSG00000264832.1` (releases 68-75) both exist at releases 68-75: the bridge joins two genes that lived side by side, so the gene it enters is not one that came after the gene it leaves. A bridge's gene is a plausible successor at that place, not one that Ensembl's history proves.

cautions.label: all 53 ids of one gene
cautions.text: The 53 targets are the ids `ENSG00000204179.12` carries in RefSeq_mRNA at release 115. IDTrack converts at the level of the gene: the identifier is read as its gene and followed as a gene, and the answer in the database asked is every id of the best gene there, not the counterpart of `ENSP00000421999.1` alone.

cautions.label: lowest Ensembl score 0.99
cautions.text: The lowest of Ensembl's mapping scores on the path of the best answer is 0.99, at releases 114 → 115 (`ENSG00000204179.11` → `ENSG00000204179.12`). The candidate's score is the product of the scores along its path.
